subject: [PATCH v7 6/6] docs: fuse: document io-uring buffer pool and zero-copy uapi

2026-08-14.patch_summary: This patch adds documentation to the Linux kernel's FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace) subsystem, specifically covering its usage of io-uring buffer pools and zero-copy functionality. The new documentation explains how buffer pools decouple entries from payload buffers, allowing for more efficient memory management and reducing overhead. It also describes zero-copy, which enables servers to read from or write to client pages without an intermediary copy, requiring CAP_SYS_ADMIN privileges. This patch aims to improve the understanding of FUSE's io-uring features and their benefits.
